P_original_final_accounting.scope: Recorded instrumented Lean build transactions including their monitoring-child CPU; no claim of complete machine CPU usage. Sources, failed attempts, clean rebuilds and duplicate compiled outputs retained. Disk is a pre-manifest snapshot.

Q_latest_current_source_incremental_math.acceptance_limit: Receipt source SHA matches final package manifest; outputs are NOT rehashed in this lightweight accounting snapshot. Existing proof/build audits establish acceptance separately.

Q_successful_nonselected_or_superseded_s.meaning: Successful attempts omitted from latest-current-source math subset: older/repeated builds, emitter modules or nonfinal diagnostic modules; not mathematical failures.

storage_P.limit: Metadata estimate; no payload read. APFS shared extents/compression can make exclusive physical occupancy differ. Toolchain/cache symlink targets are excluded.

portable_payload_excluding_private_build.limit: Metadata estimate; no payload read. APFS shared extents/compression can make exclusive physical occupancy differ. Toolchain/cache symlink targets are excluded.

snapshot_limit: Only terminal canonical attempt receipts. Active coherent compilers have uncounted partial CPU, so clean/combined totals are lower bounds until natural completion. CPU includes resource-monitor children for shared runner jobs; no global machine or foreign solver accounting.
not_additive: Latest-current-source subset is contained in Q incremental compiler attempts.
Package .build child receipts are contained in already-counted integration/jobs parent transactions.
Copied receipts, CONTROL_RESULTS, component unions, batch totals and summary receipts are not additional CPU.
P final accounting is not added to its P recount; use one representation.
Storage package payload is a subset of Q, not additional to Q.
refresh_procedure: Wait for controller natural terminal; do not stop or restart workers for accounting.
Rerun this script with a new --output-prefix, including appended final clean roots.
Use canonical lane/runs and lane/jobs plus coherent_math_001/runs once each; deduplicate by receipt path.
Keep portable nested leaf build receipts as diagnostic detail only because their parent job CPU already includes them.
Refresh final source/module acceptance separately with actual source and output hashes; this light report does not rehash compiled artifacts.
At final packaging use the curated source/data manifest and exclude .lake/.build symlinks and private outputs.
